visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white frilly halter-neck mini dress and white block heels, walks towards a black ornate metal fence. She is positioned in the center of the frame, walking away from the camera initially. Behind her, a massive, brightly lit multi-story luxury building with the words 'WYNN PALACE' visible in gold illumination stands against the dark night sky. In front of the building, a large choreographed water fountain display is active, shooting jets of water high into the air. The lighting is warm and bright, originating from the hotel’s numerous windows and the fountain's underwater spotlights. (2) The woman stops at the fence, leaning her arms against the top rail. She turns her head to her right, looking back at the camera with a soft smile. Her facial expression is relaxed and happy. The fountain in the background continues its rhythmic display, creating a dynamic backdrop of white water jets against the dark lake. The architectural details of the building's lower levels, featuring arched windows and decorative moldings, are clearly visible. (3) She poses by leaning back against the fence, facing the camera more directly. She raises her right hand to gently touch her hair, brushing it back from her face. She maintains a cheerful, engaged expression, looking directly into the lens. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing her full body as she stands on the paved walkway. The warm glow of the surrounding urban environment highlights the texture of her white dress. (4) The woman turns slightly to her left, looking back over her shoulder towards the camera while still leaning against the fence. She smiles broadly, showing her teeth. Her hair flows naturally in the light breeze. The fountain behind her shifts its pattern, with taller jets of water appearing in the center of the pool. The 'WYNN PALACE' sign on the central tower remains a clear focal point in the upper background. (5) She remains leaning against the fence, laughing and smiling brightly at the camera. She shifts her weight slightly, posing with a confident and joyful demeanor. The camera captures her from a slightly closer medium-full shot distance. The vibrant night lighting of the Macau cityscape creates a high-contrast cinematic atmosphere. The text overlays are absent, and the scene is focused entirely on her interaction with the camera against the landmark background.
